# accounting/services/sharedPool

The shared merchant-pattern pool (learning loop PR 2, Hein's decisions 2026-10-21). Opted-in bureau clients pool merchant -> category knowledge; a company with no own match gets a cold-start suggestion "Common at other ISAFlow clients". SECURITY REVIEW ITEM: `docs/security/shared-merchant-patterns.md`.

## Files
- `merchantPiiFilter.ts` — pure. `filterMerchant(text)` -> `{ ok, merchant }` or `{ ok: false, reason }`; `poolMerchantKey`. Rejects people, identifiers, salary/transfer wording, free text; the key is the known brand alone, else the first 2 words. When unsure, reject. The job and the reader MUST both use it.
- `merchantCategories.ts` — the fixed 30-category list (`MERCHANT_CATEGORIES`, list version 1), aliases for auto-map, `normaliseAccountName`. Canonical; migration 905 seeds the table from it (a unit test fails on drift). Never rename/delete a code.
- `merchantPool.ts` — pure aggregation: `aggregatePool(observations, eligible)` (filter first, one company = one majority vote, ties abstain, publish at `MIN_DISTINCT_COMPANIES` = 5 and `MIN_AGREEMENT` = 0.8, poolable only); `accountToCategory` (an account two categories map to is ignored).
- `sharedPoolJob.ts` — `runSharedPoolAggregation()`, the ONLY writer: loads every eligible company's patterns (learned/manual), plain-text rules and decided lines (excluding pool-accepted and hand-corrected auto-posts), aggregates, then `shared_pool_publish` (full replace). Refuses to run inside a request (ALS store present).
- `sharedSuggestionService.ts` — `getSharedSuggestions(companyId, lines)` / `getSharedSuggestion`: filter -> `shared_pool_lookup` (eligibility + active-company membership in SQL) -> the company's own mapping -> `CategorizationResult` with `matchSource: 'shared_pool'`, confidence >= 0.6. Non-fatal (own savepoint).
- `categoryMappingService.ts` — `listCategoryMappings`, `saveCategoryMapping` (own active account only), `autoMapCategories` (exact unique alias match on unmapped categories), pure `proposeAutoMappings`.

## Caller contract
- `bulkCategorize` (core/smartCategorizationService) calls `getSharedSuggestions` for lines rules/patterns/history left unmatched, BEFORE the LLM residual pass; the result is written with `suggested_strategy = 'shared_pool'` and logged via `recordSuggestionsShown` (source `shared_pool`).
- `autoPostGate.evaluate` refuses `shared_pool` first, before any setting: never auto-posted.
- Job: `POST /api/cron/shared-merchant-pool` (CRON_SECRET; timer files `scripts/isaflow-shared-merchant-pool.*`, not installed) and `POST /api/admin/shared-merchant-pool` (withAdmin; queued with `runAfterCommit`).
- Mapping: `GET|POST /api/accounting/category-mappings`, page `/accounting/merchant-categories`.

## Business rules
- Eligibility = `isCompanyPoolEligible` (bureau/services/poolEligibility.ts): at least one bureau and every linked bureau opted in. Repeated in SQL inside `shared_pool_lookup`.
- The pool stores categories, never accounts or anything tenant-identifying; app roles have no privilege on `shared_merchant_patterns` (deny-all, 906). `tests/unit/sharedPool/sharedPoolTableGuard.test.ts` pins the columns and the two doors.
- Thresholds are also CHECKs on the table; changing them is a migration.
